verdict.rationale: Agent-readable documentation is a fair question for a SaaS product with public docs, so the axis applies. Direct probes found no llms.txt (HTTP 404), no markdown docs endpoint (404) and no OpenAPI spec (all paths 404). The MCP-client integrations let Shortwave's own AI connect to other servers; that is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
